subject: Closure sweep (owner-directed): 16 open PRs triaged — merge batch, keep-open reasons, and 3 decisions for you
body:
Owner directed: close all open items unless there is a good reason to keep them open; keep everything current. I triaged all 16 open PRs (gh is authenticated on the Mac now). Merging is yours per DR-037 — here is the plan.

DONE (Mac lane, this pass):
- Deleted mac/attach-signal-domain (bbd64848, the superseded #753 rebuild) and 9 superseded tick branches (kept mac/tick-20260921T140443Z).
- Re-minted mac-run.json (d0ed0362) — readiness 100% on all three dimensions.

GREEN & READY TO MERGE (please merge, non-owner-gated, mine):
- #1012 (DR-054 silent-stall sweep) — CLEAN.
- #997 (spec-kit lean hybrid) — CLEAN.
- #1017 (iOS AX record), #1021 (video-intake plugin-eval), #1016 (esbuild 0.28), #1006 (iOS containment tests) — were failing 'Typecheck/proof scaffold' + 'Mac-only checks' on STALE bases; I ran `gh pr update-branch` on all four to freshen them onto current mainline, CI is re-running. Merge when green. NOTE #1016 (esbuild 0.27->0.28) should merge BEFORE anyone re-mints evidence, or local node_modules drift re-triggers the CycloneDX-SBOM gate (that is what my first re-mint hit).

YOURS — I am NOT touching:
- #1019 (raise-your-hand one system) folds #1011 + #1014; when it lands, #1011/#1014 close. CLEAN.
- #1005 (DR-043 live attach rules, supersedes the #753 you closed) — owner-gated, waits on the gitleaks legacy_125khz false-positive.

KEEP OPEN, good reason (stated so they do not read as rot):
- #439 lane mailbox — standing, never merge.
- #725 (DR-053 inert live-connector) — DRAFT, owner-gated; awaits the owner's DR-053 decision.

THREE DECISIONS I NEED FROM YOU (all CONFLICTING now; per the #753 lesson I will NOT rebuild speculatively):
1. #686 (DR-036 launch proof bindings, 'owner merges', lane/cloud branch): its mechanism — readiness dimension (b) as a fail-closed ratio that counts only evidence covering the launch surface — already appears LANDED on mainline (check-readiness-figure.mjs, dimension (b) is green+fresh+fingerprint). If it is superseded, CLOSE it with that reason. It is your lane's branch, so your call.
2. #905 (DR-052 independent-evaluation stage) — mine, reviewed (two Codex rounds), now CONFLICTING with mainline. Still wanted? If yes I will rebuild the merge (types/manifest/CLAIM_INVENTORY, like #753) — but only on your confirm, so I don't rebuild something already superseded.
3. #929 (app-protection MAM dimension) — mine, CONFLICTING, 13 failing checks, oldest of the batch. Superseded or worth reviving? If superseded, I'll close it.

I'll watch the four freshened PRs to green and report. Everything above is current as of SignalGrid_Alpha tip after this message.
